name: player receiving yards per target and per reception render different season values (executed-result parity)
description: Seed 3 targets in 2024, of which 2 are completions for 10 and 20 receiving yards. Per reception is 30/2 = 15.00; per target is 30/3 = 10.00. Until 2026-08-19 the per-target column was byte-identical to the per-reception column and both rendered 15.00.
expected_query: with "t00ee1b47d93e01c805aa643c0db3ef8d" as materialized (select COALESCE(target_pid) as pid, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_completion = true THEN receiving_yards ELSE 0 END)::decimal / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN is_completion = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) as rec_yds_per_rec_from_plays, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_completion = true THEN receiving_yards ELSE 0 END)::decimal / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN target_pid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) as rec_yds_per_trg_from_plays from "nfl_plays" where "play_type" in ('PASS', 'RUSH', 'KOFF', 'PUNT', 'FGXP', 'FREE') and "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2024) group by COALESCE(target_pid)), "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2024]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years) select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "t00ee1b47d93e01c805aa643c0db3ef8d"."rec_yds_per_rec_from_plays" AS "rec_yds_per_rec_from_plays_0", "t00ee1b47d93e01c805aa643c0db3ef8d"."rec_yds_per_trg_from_plays" AS "rec_yds_per_trg_from_plays_0", "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years" on "player_years"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "t00ee1b47d93e01c805aa643c0db3ef8d" on "t00ee1b47d93e01c805aa643c0db3ef8d"."pid" = "player"."pid" where player.primary_position IN ('MLB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "t00ee1b47d93e01c805aa643c0db3ef8d"."rec_yds_per_rec_from_plays", "t00ee1b47d93e01c805aa643c0db3ef8d"."rec_yds_per_trg_from_plays", "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
